parts.name: body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main white housing of the printer, featuring a matte plastic finish and enclosing the internal mechanisms.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support and protection for the internal printing components and electronics.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper would grasp the sides or top edges of the shell to lift or move the entire printer unit.
physics.reason: Printer housings are injection-molded thin-walled shells enclosing air and components, not solid blocks.

parts.description: The main white housing of the printer, featuring a matte plastic finish and enclosing the internal mechanisms.
parts.function: Provides structural support and protection for the internal printing components and electronics.

parts.name: output shadow

physics.Basic_description: A dark recessed area at the front bottom where paper exits, appearing as a shadow or internal cavity surface.
physics.Functional_description: The exit slot area where printed pages emerge from the internal rollers.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; it is an internal cavity surface.
physics.reason: Represents the inner surface of the plastic housing cavity.

parts.description: A dark recessed area at the front bottom where paper exits, appearing as a shadow or internal cavity surface.
parts.function: The exit slot area where printed pages emerge from the internal rollers.

parts.name: brand plate

physics.Basic_description: A small blue rectangular badge on the front left face, likely a logo or brand indicator.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the manufacturer's branding or model series.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to be a primary grasp point; would be avoided.
physics.reason: Small badge is likely a solid thin plastic insert or sticker.

parts.description: A small blue rectangular badge on the front left face, likely a logo or brand indicator.

physics.Basic_description: A small yellow circular button or indicator light on the front right face.

physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; too small and potentially fragile.

parts.description: A small yellow circular button or indicator light on the front right face.

parts.name: scanner glass

physics.Basic_description: The black rectangular flatbed surface on top, representing the glass platen under the lid.
physics.Functional_description: The transparent surface where documents are placed for scanning or copying.
physics.Grasped_description: Should not be grasped directly to avoid fingerprints or breakage; gripper should avoid this surface.
physics.reason: Scanner platens are solid sheets of glass, typically 2-4mm thick.

parts.description: The black rectangular flatbed surface on top, representing the glass platen under the lid.
parts.function: The transparent surface where documents are placed for scanning or copying.

parts.name: lid frame

physics.Basic_description: The white structural frame of the scanner lid, visible in the open position.
physics.Functional_description: Supports the scanner lid cover and provides rigidity when closing.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could grasp the edge of the lid frame to open or close the scanner unit.
physics.reason: Lid frames are molded plastic shells, hollow to reduce weight.

parts.name: cover top

physics.Basic_description: The top surface of the scanner lid, white and flat.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the document feeder or glass when closed and provides a surface for stacking.
physics.Grasped_description: Graspable by the edge to manipulate the lid, though the top surface is flat.
physics.reason: Top cover is a thin-walled plastic shell.

parts.description: The top surface of the scanner lid, white and flat.
parts.function: Protects the document feeder or glass when closed and provides a surface for stacking.

parts.name: hinge barrel

physics.Basic_description: The cylindrical hinge mechanism connecting the lid to the body, likely hidden or small.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the scanner lid to pivot open and closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; it is a mechanical joint component.
physics.reason: Hinge pins/barrels are typically solid plastic or metal for strength.

parts.description: The cylindrical hinge mechanism connecting the lid to the body, likely hidden or small.

physics.Functional_description: Supports printed paper as it exits the printer to prevent curling or falling.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper can grasp the front edge or lip of the tray to extend or retract it.
physics.reason: Output trays are thin ribbed plastic structures, mostly air underneath.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
